instruction: Could you move the text layer to the top-right corner? I need it positioned in the upper-right area of the canvas.

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the text layer to the top-right corner. The evaluator checks if the rightmost dark pixel is within the right 5% and topmost pixel is within the top 5% of the image.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: instruction requires moving text to top-right corner, evaluator verifies text position in top-right region
Adaptive text detection: metric samples background brightness and adjusts threshold dynamically to detect both dark text on light backgrounds and light text on dark backgrounds
Improved position verification: checks both bounding box center (center_x > 85%, center_y < 15%) and extremes (max_x > 95%, min_y < 5%) to ensure bulk of text is positioned correctly
Edge case handling: returns 0.0 if no text pixels found, correctly failing when text is missing
Postconfig correctly exports image to PNG using Shift+Ctrl+E for verification
Binary scoring (1.0/0.0) is appropriate for this positional verification task
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Background sampling only uses top corners - consider sampling from multiple regions or near the text location for more accurate background estimation in gradient/complex backgrounds
Threshold calculation (0.7x and 1.3x multipliers) may struggle with mid-tone text on mid-tone backgrounds - consider using a minimum contrast threshold
